name: io.github.leonardosepulvedat/mcp-n8n
description: Operate and build n8n: 55 tools for workflows, executions, credentials, users and projects, plus node catalog, validation, surgical edits, webhook testing, and automatic snapshots with rollback.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the n8n instance (e.g. https://your-n8n-instance.com)

environmentVariables.name: N8N_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose: core, builder, admin (default: all)
